ctx.x: That's right. But in New York, no. It's always something happening, and that I miss. And I hope one day to really I think that I may go back one day. Just -- but I go back once a year now just to listen and to see everybody and I saw Panama Francis there. You know, he was out here for a while, and he was doing very well but he just never got New York out of his system, so he finally said I've just got to go back, and he went back, and I saw him, he

had a big grin on his face, he was playing with Illinois Jacket. Jacques And this band, Illinois' band, was Hank Jones, Percy Heath, Panama, and Tiny Grimes. And it was just -- the band was popping, and Jacket when he saw me it was just beautiful. He ran over and hugged me and played his bassoon, I believe. This was his new instrument, he plays it very well.
